LESSON: RELATIONS WITH PEOPLE OF OTHER FAITHS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Relations with people of other faiths

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Relations with people of other faiths
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How should Muslims relate with people of other faiths?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the rights of non-Muslims for harmonious living
2. describe ways of promoting good relations with people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence
3. demonstrate ways of living harmoniously with people of other faiths in day-to-day life
4. appreciate living with people of other faiths harmoniously
